prompt: here's my plan: we ship the new billing service behind a feature flag next sprint, backfill invoices with a one-off script the same week, and delete the old billing tables the sprint after. play devil's advocate on this before I commit to it - what could go wrong?
expectations: The inline proposal is written to a file before the review so both roles read the same fixed text
The review attacks deleting the old billing tables one sprint after cutover (lost rollback/audit path, reconciliation window too short)
The review attacks the backfill timing or integrity (drift between live writes and the one-off script, idempotency, verification against the old tables)
Every objection includes a concrete failure scenario or evidence and a proposed better way
A final report separates conceded/agreed changes from contested or open points
The output ends with a recommendation and explicitly leaves the final decision to the user
